claims.hypothesis: IRAC and VLA counterparts allow robust ALMA detections below 4.8 sigma
claims.experiment: Cross-matching 3.5-4.8 sigma peaks with IRAC/VLA, with negative-image and deeper-survey checks
claims.result: 16 sources with purity checks; all 3 in deeper surveys recovered; KS p=0.012 vs 0.88 after removal

evidence.quote: This suggests that not only the Supplementary Catalog is robust but also that there is little margin for an extra population of real sources that we would have missed.

claims.hypothesis: Fainter ALMA sources differ in properties from the Main Catalog
claims.experiment: Compare redshift, mass and size distributions
claims.result: Lower median mass, wider redshift range, sizes ~twice larger
claims.finding: Pushing the limit reaches lower-mass galaxies with more extended dust emission

evidence.quote: in which dust-enshrouded star formation extends over twice larger sizes

claims.hypothesis: HST astrometry needs a local distortion correction
claims.experiment: Compare HST, Pan-STARRS, VLA and ALMA positions
claims.result: Spatially coherent residual offsets up to >0.15''
claims.finding: Correction is needed to avoid wrong counterparts

evidence.quote: can reach values higher than 0.15$''$ at the edge of our GOODS-ALMA survey
